display.mark: Zaɓi allunanka na tawadar lantarki don kunna daidaitawa.
hardware.notice.title: Fara saita bambancin haske a allonka
hardware.notice.body: A cikin menu na allon kansa, zaɓi **matakin bambancin hasken kayan aiki mai daidaito ko ɗan ƙasa** don samun sakamako mafi kyau daga wannan manhaja.
hardware.notice.bigme: Misali, Bigme B251 Pro (R2 FW V2.0): Web Mode, Hardware Gamma Level 3, Contrast 50, a kashe Color Restore Mode.
saturation.title: Ƙarfin launi
saturation.caption: Don tawadar lantarki mai launi: yana rama ƙarancin faɗin launuka. Ana maido da shi idan an fita daga manhajar.
saturation.mhc2.compat: Hanyar MHC2 ta Windows 10: an tabbatar da ita a kayan aikin da aka gwada. Tallafi ya dogara da allo da direba; fita yana maido da bayanin launi na asali.
rgb.title: RGB
text.title: Bambancin hasken rubutu
text.caption: Yana duhun rubutu don a iya karanta shi a allo mai ƙarancin bambancin haske. Don karatu.
video.title: Inganta bidiyo (haskaka wuraren duhu)
video.caption: Yana haskaka wuraren duhu kawai. Kunna don bidiyo da hotuna.
video.warning: Rubutu ya fi haske: %@. Zai fi kyau a kashe yayin karatu.
video.blocked: A kashe yayin da Bambancin hasken rubutu yake kunne: suna amfani da teburin kayan aiki ɗaya kuma tasirinsu ya saɓa wa juna.
cost.13: bambancin hasken rubutu ya ragu da kusan 13%
cost.34: bambancin hasken rubutu ya ragu da kusan 34%
cost.56: bambancin hasken rubutu ya ragu da kusan 56%
text.detail.medium: Duhun da ake iya gani — tsohon matakin Mai ƙarfi.
text.detail.strong: Duhun mai tsanani, har da rubutun sakandare.
text.detail.sharp: Mai ƙarfi sosai, yana tsananta kaifin gefunan rubutu marar fitowa sosai.
text.detail.solid: Bambancin haske mafi girma tare da danne sautunan kusa da baƙi sosai: ya fi duhu, amma ana rasa bayanan toka da gefuna masu laushi.
help.title: Yadda yake aiki
help.saturation: Ƙarfin launi da RGB (tawadar lantarki mai launi): suna sake rubuta bayanin launin allo don rama ƙarancin faɗin launuka da karkatar launi. Allunan baƙi da fari za su iya barinsu a 100%.
help.video: Inganta bidiyo: yana haskaka sautunan da suka fi duhu kawai. Ba ya canza sautunan tsakiya ko wuraren haske.
help.tradeoff: Ba zai iya bambanta bidiyo mai duhu da rubutu mai duhu ba, don haka bambancin hasken rubutu yana raguwa. Ya fi tsanani a Yanayin duhu. Yi amfani da shi don bidiyo, kashe don karatu.
help.volatile: Duk saitunan nan suna buƙatar manhajar tana aiki: fita yana maido da allunanka, buɗewa yana sake amfani da saitunanka.
error.saturation: An kasa amfani da ƙarfin launi ga %@.
error.color: An kasa amfani da daidaitawar launi ga %@.
error.login: An kasa canza buɗewa lokacin shiga.

advanced.title: Na ci gaba
advanced.note: Yana maye gurbin saitunan da aka riga aka tsara a sama da lanƙwasar da ka saita da kanka.
curve.gamma: Gamma (ƙasa da 1 yana haskakawa, sama da 1 yana duhunawa)
presets.title: Lanƙwasoshin da aka ajiye
presets.hint: Danna gurbi mara komai don ajiye lanƙwasar yanzu, ko wanda aka ajiye don amfani da ita. Danna dama don maye gurbi ko sharewa.
shaking.title: Rage rawa
shaking.info: Yana kashe haɗa launi da ɗigon pixels a wannan allo. macOS yana amfani da wannan hanya a fitarwa don laushin sauyin launi; allon tawadar lantarki yana riƙe kowane pixel, don haka tsarin yana bayyana a matsayin kyalli mai ci gaba. Tasiri iri ɗaya da Stillcolor, amma ana amfani da shi ga allo ɗaya maimakon duka.
role.title: Kashe Night Shift da True Tone ga %@ kawai
role.note: Yana buƙatar kalmar sirrin mai gudanarwa. Ba a soke canjin idan an fita daga manhajar ba.
role.restart: Cire haɗin wannan allo sannan ka sake haɗa shi don amfani da canjin.

welcome.bigme.body: Yi amfani da Web Mode, Hardware Gamma Level 3, Contrast 50, sannan a kashe Color Restore Mode.

welcome.hide: Kada a sake nuna wannan shawara
system.title: Rage ganin bayan abubuwa da motsi
system.hint: Dukansu suna taimaka wa tawadar lantarki: ganin bayan abubuwa yana dusashe rubutu, kuma motsin hoto ba ya da amfani a allo mai jinkiri.
system.toggle: Rage ganin bayan abubuwa da motsi
system.guide: Shigar da mataimakin E-Ink Assistant don sarrafa saitunan biyu tare.
system.ready: Yi amfani da maɓallin sauyawa don kunna ko kashe saitunan biyu.
system.installing: Ana jiran tabbatar da Ƙara gajeriyar hanya a Shortcuts…
system.failed: Ba a sami mataimakin ba. Tabbatar da shigo da shi, ko zaɓi Sake shigar da mataimaki a Zaɓuɓɓuka.
system.auto: Bi allunan tawadar lantarki ta atomatik
system.auto.note: Yana kunnawa idan an haɗa allon tawadar lantarki da aka yi wa alama, kuma yana kashewa sai bayan an cire haɗin allon ƙarshe da aka yi wa alama.
system.install.title: A shigar da mataimakin sauƙin amfani?
system.install.intro: Rage ganin bayan abubuwa da Rage motsi saitunan macOS ne na dukan tsarin. Apple yana buƙatar tabbatarwa sau ɗaya kafin E-Ink Assistant ya sarrafa su ta Shortcuts.
system.install.step1: E-Ink Assistant yana buɗe mataimakin da ya zo da shi a manhajar Shortcuts ta Apple.
system.install.step2: Duba ainihin rassansa na off/on da aikin Babu komai na ƙarshe, sannan danna Ƙara gajeriyar hanya sau ɗaya.
system.install.future: Bayan shigarwa, wannan layi zai zama maɓallin kunna/kashewa. Maimaita amfani yana da aminci; ba ya sauya saitin ba tare da bincika halinsa ba.
system.install.auto: Za ka iya zaɓar bin allunan tawadar lantarki da aka haɗa. Idan akwai alluna da yawa, kashewa yana faruwa sai bayan an cire haɗin duk allunan da aka yi wa alama.
system.install.quit: Fita daga E-Ink Assistant koyaushe yana kashe saitunan biyu.
system.install.scope: Mataimakin yana karɓar Rubutu kawai, yana gane ainihin umarnin “on” da “off”, yana watsi da sauran abubuwa, kuma ba ya fitar da sakamako. Ba ya bayyana a takardar rabawa, Spotlight, Ayyuka masu sauri, ko fuskar allo a kulle. Zai iya aiki a bango yayin da Mac yake a kulle don bin alluna ta atomatik da maido da saituna lokacin fita su kasance abin dogaro. E-Ink Assistant ba ya lissafa, bincika, ko gudanar da sauran gajerun hanyoyinka.
